questions.question: What does Hosea 13 warn about Israel forgetting?
options: The calf of gold set up in Samaria
The army of Egypt they trusted in
The king they had demanded for themselves
The LORD, who was their God and Savior
questions.answer: The LORD, who was their God and Savior

questions.question: What triumphant question about death appears in Hosea 13?
options: Who among all men has no fear at all of death and of the grave?
Why must all of the living go down at the last to the grave?
When will death at long last come to claim its very own?
O Death, where are your plagues? O Sheol, where is your sting?
questions.answer: O Death, where are your plagues? O Sheol, where is your sting?

questions.question: Hosea 13 says there is no savior besides the LORD.
O Death, where are your _____? O Sheol, where is your sting?
It was I who knew you in the wilderness, in the land of _____.
